HUB v3.0.5 for Windows

Windows Stable package: HUB-v3.0.5-release.zip.

What's new

- Curve Repair: choose Per-key easing or Continuous smoothing separately for each animation. Unassigned animations use the default settings.
- Export optimization: Off, Compact, Safe, High accuracy and Strong. Safe is the default. Compact keeps identical JSON data; Safe also removes redundant generated held keys. High accuracy and Strong approximate motion and should be previewed before use.
- Preview: compare Original with Final, or Smoothed with Optimized. Both panes share playback time. Change optimization directly in preview; Export uses the same settings. JSON size and bone-key totals are shown.
- CC Packer: automatic Spine conversion is temporarily disabled and the checkbox removed. Saved settings cannot enable it. Export compatible legacy JSON from Spine, then use the usual Preview, Pack and backup workflow.
- Updates: checks Stable when HUB is ready, or on first opening Updates if not checked yet, then continues the normal 15-minute cycle. Beta stays manual. No automatic installation.

Optimization retains the input Spine version, skeleton, atlas, textures, other timelines and animation timing. It is not a version converter. It only reduces generated bone keys; file-size savings depend on the animation. Review the final export in the game's runtime. No report file is added to export folders.

Asset Stage and Volume Match remain beta-only. No macOS release change.

Update inside HUB: Updates > Stable > Check now > Download update > Install & restart. Existing updater-enabled versions can update directly; intermediate Beta versions are not required. Settings and history are preserved. Installation needs confirmation and cannot start while an editing job is running.

For a fresh installation, extract HUB-v3.0.5-release.zip and run HUB/HUB.exe. Keep the complete HUB folder together.
